ModMetaData.name: Building Upgrades
ModMetaData.author: Tad
ModMetaData.description:
Furniture and buildings come in a quality tier (Awful..Legendary), but vanilla gives you no way to improve one after it's built - your only option is deconstructing and re-crafting from scratch.
This mod adds an Upgrade job. A construction-skilled colonist can work on a placed piece of quality furniture to attempt to raise its quality tier, consuming a share of the original build cost and following the exact same skill-based quality curve as normal construction (so a legendary result is just as possible, and just as rare, as building it fresh).
Two ways to order it: - Select a colonist and right-click an upgradable building for a one-off "Upgrade thing" order. - Toggle "Auto-upgrade" on a building (a new gizmo) to have it queued automatically for any free construction pawn, same as other work types.
A poor roll never makes the item worse than it already was - worst case you spend materials and time for no visible change.
